routing.math: integer CPMM exact-input and exact-output calculations
routing.cyclePolicy: repeated pools and repeated assets are rejected
routing.feeDisclosure: effective route rate plus each pool fee
routing.provenance: every hop carries its committed block height, update time, transaction hash and audit hash; the quote exposes the full ordered audit-hash set plus its earliest/latest block anchor
routing.directExecution: eligible for existing one-pool Wallet action contract
routing.multiHopExecution: disabled until a Central-attested atomic routed action contract exists

singleExecutableBlocker: Central/Chain Core must expose a single atomic multi-hop action and receipt contract before DEX can request a Wallet signature for any multi-hop route.
